dz: 菲律宾-美国战争正式结束.
de: The Philippine–American War is officially concluded.

dz: 威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱 (William Howard Taft) 成为美国菲律宾总督。
de: William Howard Taft becomes American governor of the Philippines.

de: En route from New York to Le Havre, the SS La Bourgogne collides with another ship and sinks with the loss of 549 lives, one of the worst maritime disasters in history.

dz: 西萨摩亚更改国际日期变更线，导致星期一（7 月 4 日）出现两次，导致闰年有 367 天。
de: Western Samoa changes the International Date Line, causing Monday (July 4) to occur twice, resulting in a leap year with 367 days.

de: The founder of Pakistan, Quaid-i-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah, joins Sindh-Madrasa-tul-Islam, Karachi.

de: The Canadian Pacific Railway's first scheduled train from Montreal arrives in Port Moody on the Pacific coast, after six days of travel.

dz: 盎格鲁-祖鲁战争:乌隆地的祖鲁兰都城被英国军队攻克并被焚毁于地,结束了战争并迫使克茨瓦约国王出逃.
de: Anglo-Zulu War: The Zululand capital of Ulundi is captured by British troops and burned to the ground, ending the war and forcing King Cetshwayo to flee.

te: Siege of Vicksburg: The Confederate army in Vicksburg, Mississippi surrenders to Union forces under Ulysses S. Grant af…
dz: 美国内战:围攻维克斯堡:联邦军在维克斯堡,密西西比州在被尤利西斯·S·格兰特围困了47天后向联合部队投降,为联邦攻克密西西比河做出了贡献.
de: American Civil War: Siege of Vicksburg: The Confederate army in Vicksburg, Mississippi surrenders to Union forces under Ulysses S. Grant after 47 days of siege, contributing to the Union capture of the Mississippi River.

t: 联军在阿肯色州海伦娜战役中击退了一支邦联军队. 这场战役挫败了起义军为缓解被围困的城市维克斯堡…
te: Union forces repulse a Confederate army at the Battle of Helena in Arkansas. The battle thwarts a Rebel attempt to reli…
dz: 美国内战:联军在阿肯色州海伦娜战役中击退了一支邦联军队. 这场战役挫败了起义军为缓解被围困的城市维克斯堡所承受的压力而作的尝试,为联盟夺取"小岩"铺平了道路.
de: American Civil War: Union forces repulse a Confederate army at the Battle of Helena in Arkansas. The battle thwarts a Rebel attempt to relieve pressure on the besieged city of Vicksburg, and paves the way for the Union capture of Little Rock.

t: 从葛底斯堡撤退:罗伯特·E·李手下的北弗吉尼亚邦联军在战败于葛底斯堡战役后从战场上撤退,标志着…
te: Retreat from Gettysburg: The Confederate Army of Northern Virginia under Robert E. Lee withdraws from the battlefield a…
dz: 美国内战:从葛底斯堡撤退:罗伯特·E·李手下的北弗吉尼亚邦联军在战败于葛底斯堡战役后从战场上撤退,标志着他最后一次入侵北方的结束.
de: American Civil War: Retreat from Gettysburg: The Confederate Army of Northern Virginia under Robert E. Lee withdraws from the battlefield after losing the Battle of Gettysburg, signaling an end to his last invasion of the North.

t: 刘易斯·卡罗尔(Lewis Carroll)向爱丽丝·利德尔(Alice Liddell)讲述…
te: Lewis Carroll tells Alice Liddell a story that would grow into Alice's Adventures in Wonderland and its sequels.
dz: 刘易斯·卡罗尔(Lewis Carroll)向爱丽丝·利德尔(Alice Liddell)讲述了一个会成长为"爱丽丝在仙境中的冒险"及其续集的故事.
de: Lewis Carroll tells Alice Liddell a story that would grow into Alice's Adventures in Wonderland and its sequels.

t: 沃尔特·惠特曼所着"诗集""草地之叶"一书的第一版在布鲁克林出版.

dz: 沃尔特·惠特曼所着"诗集""草地之叶"一书的第一版在布鲁克林出版.
de: The first edition of Walt Whitman's book of poems, Leaves of Grass, is published in Brooklyn.

t: 亨利·大卫·索罗(英语:Henry David Thoreau)搬入了马萨诸塞州康科德的瓦尔登…
te: Henry David Thoreau moves into a small cabin on Walden Pond in Concord, Massachusetts. Thoreau's account of his two yea…
dz: 亨利·大卫·索罗(英语:Henry David Thoreau)搬入了马萨诸塞州康科德的瓦尔登塘上的一个小小木屋. Thoreau在那里两年的叙述 Walden 将成为环保运动的试金石.
de: Henry David Thoreau moves into a small cabin on Walden Pond in Concord, Massachusetts. Thoreau's account of his two years there, Walden, will become a touchstone of the environmental movement.

te: The Iowa Territory is organized.
dz: 爱荷华州属地组织.
de: The Iowa Territory is organized.

dz: 大通口铁路是世界上第一条长途铁路,开通于伯明翰至利物浦之间.

dz: 约翰·尼尔在美国举办了第一场公开讲座来宣传妇女权利.
de: John Neal delivers the first public lecture in the U.S. to advocate the rights of women.

t: Samuel Francis Smith为马萨诸塞州波士顿七月四日庆典写作"我的祖国""Tis…

de: Samuel Francis Smith writes "My Country, 'Tis of Thee" for the Boston, Massachusetts July 4 festivities.

dz: 纽约州废除了奴隶制.
de: Slavery is abolished in the State of New York.

dz: 1818年的"美国国旗法"生效,为每个州创造了一面有恒星的13分旗. 每个新州入盟后的7月4日将增加新星.
de: U.S. Flag Act of 1818 goes into effect creating a 13-stripe flag with a star for each state. New stars are to be added on the July 4 following the admission of each new state to the Union.

te: In Rome, New York, construction on the Erie Canal begins.
dz: 在纽约罗马,伊利运河上开始建造.
de: In Rome, New York, construction on the Erie Canal begins.

dz: 美国独立战争：乔治·克拉克领导下的美军在伊利诺伊州战役中占领了卡斯卡斯基亚。
de: American Revolutionary War: U.S. forces under George Clark capture Kaskaskia during the Illinois campaign.

te: The United States Declaration of Independence is adopted by the Second Continental Congress, formally announcing and ex…

de: American Revolution: The United States Declaration of Independence is adopted by the Second Continental Congress, formally announcing and explaining separation from the Kingdom of Great Britain and the creation of the United States.

dz: 橙城决议(Orangetown Resolutions)被纽约省通过,这是反对英国议会强制法案的多起抗议之一.
de: Orangetown Resolutions are adopted in the Province of New York, one of many protests against the British Parliament's Coercive Acts.

t: "兰开斯特条约"(Treaty of Lancaster)中,易洛魁人将阿列根尼山脉和俄亥俄河…

de: The Treaty of Lancaster, in which the Iroquois cede lands between the Allegheny Mountains and the Ohio River to the British colonies, is signed in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.

t: 克卢希诺战役是波兰-立陶宛联邦和俄罗斯军队在波兰-俄罗斯战争中交战,之后波兰军队进入莫斯科.

de: The Battle of Klushino is fought between forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Russia during the Polish–Russian War, after which Polish troops entered Moscow.

dz: 菲利普·阿马达斯和亚瑟·巴洛抵达了罗阿诺克岛.

t: 福尔的弗朗切斯科 二世·奥尔德拉菲向教皇指挥官吉尔·德·阿尔博诺斯投降.
te: Francesco II Ordelaffi of Forlì surrenders to the Papal commander Gil de Albornoz.
dz: 福尔的弗朗切斯科 二世·奥尔德拉菲向教皇指挥官吉尔·德·阿尔博诺斯投降.
de: Francesco II Ordelaffi of Forlì surrenders to the Papal commander Gil de Albornoz.

t: 忠于高代戈皇帝的军队在镰仓围攻期间夺取了通克. 高通和高通族的其他成员自杀 结束了镰仓的统治.
te: Forces loyal to Emperor Go-Daigo seize Tōshō-ji during the Siege of Kamakura. Hōjō Takatoki and other members of the Hō…
dz: 根克战争:忠于高代戈皇帝的军队在镰仓围攻期间夺取了通克. 高通和高通族的其他成员自杀 结束了镰仓的统治.
de: Genkō War: Forces loyal to Emperor Go-Daigo seize Tōshō-ji during the Siege of Kamakura. Hōjō Takatoki and other members of the Hōjō clan commit suicide, ending the rule of the Kamakura shogunate.

t: 阿维斯内斯的约翰一世击败了丹皮耶尔的盖伊.
te: John I of Avesnes defeats Guy of Dampierre.
dz: 西卡佩尔战役:阿维斯内斯的约翰一世击败了丹皮耶尔的盖伊.
de: Battle of West-Capelle: John I of Avesnes defeats Guy of Dampierre.

t: 哈廷之战:萨拉丁击败了耶路撒冷国王卢西南的盖伊.
te: Battle of Hattin: Saladin defeats Guy of Lusignan, King of Jerusalem.
dz: 十字军:哈廷之战:萨拉丁击败了耶路撒冷国王卢西南的盖伊.
de: The Crusades: Battle of Hattin: Saladin defeats Guy of Lusignan, King of Jerusalem.

te: Jordan II of Capua is anointed as prince after his infant nephew's death.
dz: 卡普亚的乔丹二世被他幼子外甥死后被授为王子.
de: Jordan II of Capua is anointed as prince after his infant nephew's death.

t: 一颗被称作SN 1054的超新星被中国宋朝,阿拉伯人所见,可能还有星泽塔陶里附近的土着美国观察…
te: A supernova, called SN 1054, is seen by Chinese Song dynasty, Arab, and possibly indigenous American observers near the…
dz: 一颗被称作SN 1054的超新星被中国宋朝,阿拉伯人所见,可能还有星泽塔陶里附近的土着美国观察家所见. 几个月来,它仍然非常明亮,可以在白天看到。 其残留形成蟹状星云.
de: A supernova, called SN 1054, is seen by Chinese Song dynasty, Arab, and possibly indigenous American observers near the star Zeta Tauri. For several months it remains bright enough to be seen during the day. Its remnants form the Crab Nebula.

dz: 奥格斯堡的乌尔里希被封为"圣人".
de: Ulrich of Augsburg is canonized as a saint.

t: 贝内文托公国和那不勒斯公国之间的和平条约"条约"(Contractum Sicardi)已经签…

dz: 贝内文托公国和那不勒斯公国之间的和平条约"条约"(Contractum Sicardi)已经签署.
de: Pactum Sicardi, a peace treaty between the Principality of Benevento and the Duchy of Naples, is signed.

t: 赫拉克洛纳斯和大卫是拜占庭皇帝赫拉克利乌斯的儿子,分别被封为augustus和caesar,可…
te: Heraclonas and David, sons of Byzantine Emperor Heraclius, are proclaimed augustus and caesar respectively, possibly du…
dz: 赫拉克洛纳斯和大卫是拜占庭皇帝赫拉克利乌斯的儿子,分别被封为augustus和caesar,可能是由于他们的长兄赫拉克利乌斯·康斯坦丁身体不好.
de: Heraclonas and David, sons of Byzantine Emperor Heraclius, are proclaimed augustus and caesar respectively, possibly due to the bad health of their elder brother Heraclius Constantine.

t: 艾莉娅·普尔切里亚宣誓贞操并被封为"奥古斯塔"(Augusta),从而成为她13岁的弟弟特奥多…
te: Aelia Pulcheria takes a vow of chastity and is proclaimed Augusta, thus becoming the regent of the Byzantine Empire for…
dz: 艾莉娅·普尔切里亚宣誓贞操并被封为"奥古斯塔"(Augusta),从而成为她13岁的弟弟特奥多修斯二世在前任摄政王去世后成为拜占庭帝国的摄政.
de: Aelia Pulcheria takes a vow of chastity and is proclaimed Augusta, thus becoming the regent of the Byzantine Empire for her 13-year-old brother Theodosius II after the death of the previous regent, praefect Anthemius.

t: 马库斯·利西尼乌斯·克萨斯(Marcus Licinius Crassus)因在色雷斯的胜利而…

de: Marcus Licinius Crassus is granted a triumph for his victory in Thrace.
